mapper.select: SELECT ui.ID, ui.nick_name AS nickName, ui.phone, ui.headimg_url AS headimgUrl FROM user_info ui WHERE ui.id = #{userId} AND ui.del_flag = '0'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status IS NULL AND is_pay = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "0", SUM(CASE WHEN status = '1' AND is_pay = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "1", SUM(CASE WHEN status = '2' AND is_pay = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2", SUM(CASE WHEN status = '3' AND is_pay = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "3" FROM order_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0'
